review.evidence: Fresh review at Ethereum block 26197000 (hash 0x7f8f6377ac8f3948e1ac61d81c1a236b58c7ef57ef2743f18189cca1127aa66d; 2026-10-15T09:24:59Z) confirms immutable asset-funded mint and fee-share accounting, complete current sole-adapter/sole-market inventory and creation-to-pin owner/curator/allocator/sentinel role history. Owner and curator remain 1-of-1 Safes with the authored signers, no enabled modules, zero guards and nonzero fallback handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99; this is not complete execution-scope or key-custody certification. RegistryList 0x3696c5eae4a7ffd04ea163564571e9cd8ed9364e is fixed: abdicated(setAdapterRegistry(address)) is true, correcting the earlier claim that the curator could zero or replace it. RegistryList verified source still allows its owner to append subregistries, so fixed registry identity does not establish immutable allocation scope. addAdapter and both cap-increase selectors have 259200-second delays; management/performance fee, deposit-gate and force-deallocation penalty setters have zero delay. Current performanceFee is 15%, managementFee zero and forceDeallocatePenalty 1%. Adapter-wide and collateral-wide absolute caps are uint128-max; the current market absolute cap is 45000000000000 raw PYUSD and all three relative caps are 100%. These are allocation limits, not issuance ceilings. Complete creation-to-pin Transfer, Deposit and AccrueInterest logs contain minted raw shares 84777793150272847533995322, exactly matching deposit shares 84769357420986078141652090 plus fee shares 8435729286769392343232 transaction-by-transaction. Burns 72106321103682802003681774 leave raw totalSupply 12671472046590045530313548, exactly matching the pinned getter; no unexplained issuance remains. The earlier block 26115203 cumulative mint/burn figures were independently reproduced from the same history. This technical conservation proof is not independent financial assurance or stressed recovery proof. The prior scoped no-incident search retains its historical date. Signer identity, independent key custody, whole-holder legal protections and independently assured reconciliation remain unresolved.
